library_seed.description: Pinned third-party Lean source, Git metadata, and compiled modules; checker-owned for accepted runs.

verifier_context.description: Four context words recomputed from the selected package by the pilot and opening gates.

pilot_fixture.description: Current complete Lean standalone pilot result and its serialized input.

piccs_ownership.description: Current Lean PiCCS physical row and column ownership audit.

recursive_fixture.description: Current recursive caller fixture, consuming the preceding base proof and actual children.

recursive_phase_input.description: Complete PiCCS input and proof for the actual-child recursive case.

recursive_lean_result.description: Complete executable Lean result for recursive_phase_input.

recursive_opening_cache.description: The recursive fresh opening carrier, matrix images, and metadata.

folded_cache.description: The actual first-fold parent carrier and its metadata.

child_commitments.description: All sixteen child commitment and public-input records.

child_input_evaluations.description: K and all fourteen child A families at the prior point.

child_output_evaluations.description: K and all fourteen child A families at the accepted new point.

child_running.description: The complete sixteen-child running statement consumed by the recursive caller.

decomposition.scope: Exact proof-step statement, permitted premises, substantive argument, Lean correspondence, and use in the registered parent obligation.

target-meaning.scope: Exact pilot/PiCCS target propositions, permitted inputs, and meaning dependencies.

formula-coverage.scope: Every PiCCS v1_1 conjunct, child connection, layout, validity requirement, and mutation expectation on this exact source snapshot.

production.scope: Separate owner approval of the production verifier, exclusive relation, key, and public-input binding.

pilot-formula-coverage.scope: Exact pilot HyperNova hash/preimage and public-input obligations, current row owners, complete values, and mutation expectations on this source snapshot.

pilot-assignment.gap: Selected accepted rows must imply both pilot child contracts in the decoded assignment.
pilot-assignment.argument: Project the selected fixed-point row plan to the pilot hash, arithmetic, and binding rows. Apply the existing decoded-environment equalities and the two-child pilot assembler.

piccs-assignment.gap: Selected accepted rows must imply the complete PiCCS phase predicate in the same decoded environment.
piccs-assignment.argument: Project the ordinary, Poseidon, and endpoint row families from the same selected assignment. Derive all twelve child contracts in one decoded environment, then apply the complete PiCCS phase assembler.

piccs-public-assignment.gap: The actual public projection and selected rows must imply the PiCCS phase, prior-running agreement, fresh public hash, and claimed output hash without a separate one-cell or representation premise. The complete typed Stage 1 step and selected-context boundary remain open.
piccs-public-assignment.argument: Derive the one cell from the actual public marker, apply the opaque decoded PiCCS phase theorem, then compose typed running-input agreement and both actual hash observations.

stage1-assignment.gap: The full arbitrary emitted-assignment-to-decoded-StepHoldsFor target and closure are still required; the generic Represents theorem does not discharge this connection.

compiler-coverage.gap: The registered declaration and axiom inventory must match every PiCCS compiler obligation. Independent formula review must check the exact statements, premises, and connections.

piccs-conformance.gap: Both the base and actual-child recursive PiCCS cases need exact matrices, independently valid openings and assignments, complete results, exact handoffs, and all required mutations on the selected candidate.

piccs-coverage.gap: Each named PiCCS branch must pass its registered checks on the selected source and inputs. Independent review must confirm the complete required branch set and its correspondence to the verifier conjuncts.

base-positive.scope: A valid nonzero fresh opening with 16 zero running openings. This does not show nonzero-running acceptance.

actual-child-recursive-positive.scope: The preceding output produces 16 actual digit openings: six nonzero digits and ten zero high digits. All child commitments and both evaluation points are independently checked; no signed-copy substitution is used.

complete-phase-result.scope: The 15-field result checks acceptance, alpha, gamma, pre-SumCheck state, all 28 round challenges and states, outgoing point, initial and round claims, all terminal identities, 17 commitments/public inputs/Eval_K families, 238 Eval_A families, and outgoing state. The six-field Lean envelope also contains the identical full serialized input/proof and complete decoded running statement.

proof-mutations.scope: Both Rust engines reject a missing round, missing coefficient, and every extension limb of every coefficient of every round. 2 + 28*10*2 = 562 cases per positive fixture. The harness checks full positive Lean/Rust results first; it does not execute Lean once for each mutated proof.

statement-mutations.scope: Both engines reject all four shared prior-digest word changes, inconsistent prior point/digest, nonzero running padding in K/A, one changed value from each of 17 families for each of 16 running sources, and changed fresh commitment/public input. 282 cases per fixture.

common-prior-point.scope: The nonzero-running case rejects changes to both limbs of all 28 common coordinates: 56 cases. Zero openings remain valid at any common point; for that case the parent hash gate owns rejection with the old public digest.

output-mutations.scope: For each of 17 outputs, both engines reject changes to 17 families, 28 point coordinates, and four digest words. Ten malformed shape/padding cases also reject: 17*(17+28+4)+10 = 843 per fixture.

assignment-and-ownership.scope: Canonical row checks are separate from positive value parity. The tests cover physical/logical assignments, matrix mutations, public markers/segments, row/column owners, and changed generated values. Detached application and PiRLC product coordinates have explicit rejection gates.

piccs-coverage.argument: Check a valid nonzero fresh opening with zero running openings and the actual-child recursive case. Independently check both child evaluation points, every source family and raw assignment. Compare the complete accepted phase results, then reject proof, statement, point, output, row, column and public-input mutations. A changed common point in the zero-running case is bound by the parent hash; the direct point-rejection gate uses nonzero running openings. These executions do not replace independent formula or branch review.

production.gap: The owner-approved production verifier and exclusive lifecycle binding remain outside this tool's initial scope.

pilot-conformance.gap: The current standalone pilot and positive PiCCS parent need complete values, canonical raw rows, owner mutations, and an independent formula review.
